name: Stalking the Stalkers
summary: In Revantusk, Huntsman Markhor names the wolves threatening the village's hunters. He asks you to turn the hunt on them.

sections.title: Wolves in Hiding
sections.body: The Hinterlands wilds have already claimed many trolls. Markhor counts Silvermane wolves among the greatest dangers to Revantusk's hunters. They hide among bushes and in the lay of the land, then pounce when the moment is right. He urges you to think as a Silvermane does and hunt the hunters. Every one must be put down.

sections.title: What Markhor Asks
sections.body: Markhor asks you to kill fifteen Silvermane Stalkers and fifteen Silvermane Howlers. They lurk in the Hinterlands wilds.

sections.title: Revantusk's Thanks
sections.body: When the hunt is done, Markhor thanks you for what you have given the Revantusk.

faq.q: Who asks for the wolves to be hunted?
faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor, of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, asks you to hunt the wolves.

faq.q: Why are the Silvermane wolves such a threat?
faq.answer: Silvermane wolves hide among bushes and the lay of the land, then strike when the chance comes. Markhor ranks them among the greatest dangers to Revantusk's hunters, and many trolls have already been lost in the wilds.

faq.q: Which wolves need to be culled?
faq.answer: You are asked to hunt fifteen Silvermane Stalkers and fifteen Silvermane Howlers.
The wolves lurk in the Hinterlands wilds.

attribution: Classic quest text: Stalking the Stalkers
